cues: The second product, the vector or cross product, gives a vector.
Its length is a b sin theta, which is exactly the area of the parallelogram on a and b.
Its direction is perpendicular to both, chosen by the right hand rule: curl your fingers from a to b, and your thumb points along a cross b.
